strings.zh: 华蓝市去过了吗？{NEWLINE}海角的视野不错吧？{CLEAR}是有名的约会地点呢,{CLEAR}你有喜欢的人吗？{SCROLL}……　……　……{SCROLL}不好意思,光问你话了。
strings.en: Have you been to Cerulean City? The{NEWLINE}view from the Cape is great, isn’t it?{SCROLL}It’s a famous date spot. Is there{NEWLINE}someone you like?{SCROLL}... ... ...{SCROLL}Sorry, I’ve been asking all the{NEWLINE}questions.

strings.zh: 不好意思,{NEWLINE}现在金黄市的出入口已经戒严了,{CLEAR}你如果想从这里进入金黄市的话,{CLEAR}过段时间再来吧。
strings.en: Sorry, but Saffron City’s gates are{NEWLINE}under lockdown right now.{SCROLL}If you want to enter Saffron City from{NEWLINE}here, please come back later.
